name: cross-file-consistency
prompt: Same board. Before dispatching Phase 1, reconcile what the templates, the gate blocks, the decomposition guide and the flow all say about the same decision.
expected_output: One answer per question, wherever the agent looks. A rule stated in a template is not contradicted by a gate block, a guide, or SKILL.md.

assertions.text: the requirements lock is never satisfied by pointing at the design's own file: a lock citing ARCHITECTURE.md is met by any self-consistent design, which is the failure mode the lock exists to prevent
assertions.cmd: ! sed -n '/## Requirements Lock/,/## Design Reference/p' skills/jitx/references/plan-template.md | grep -q 'see ARCHITECTURE.md'

assertions.text: no file claims a predefined substrate needs no task; the four files that discuss it agree the task exists and narrows to selection plus verification
assertions.cmd: ! grep -rqE 'no task needed|skip the substrate task|no substrate modeling task needed' --exclude-dir=evals skills/jitx/

assertions.text: the layout in SKILL.md defines every directory the template's Verify commands build from, substrate.py and constraints/ included
assertions.cmd: sed -n '/^project\//,/^```$/p' skills/jitx/SKILL.md | grep -q 'substrate.py' && sed -n '/^project\//,/^```$/p' skills/jitx/SKILL.md | grep -q 'constraints/'

assertions.text: the engineering-question cap is stated once and identically in the template and the decomposition guide
parts-sourcing does not both require and forbid the rationale table in PLAN.md
assertions.cmd: ! grep -q 'Record chosen parts in PLAN.md\*\* with MPN, package, key specs, data source, and the \*\*component-choice rationale table' skills/jitx/references/parts-sourcing.md

assertions.text: an agent following the bundle end to end never has to choose between two conflicting instructions
